name: OMTech FC-510 Intelli
tagline: OMTech FC-510 Intelli-Cut: mid-size fiber cutting platform
tldr: OMTech FC-510 Intelli is a larger fiber cutting machine than the FC-44/105 desk units: aimed at sheet metal and industrial-style cuts with Intelli-Cut features, not hobby diode work.
mainObjective: Shop fiber cutting beyond desktop marking machines

priceRange.note: Official OMTech store, Oct 2026: listed at $76,999 (quote-based; 1.5 to 4 kW IPG source)

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

pros: Fiber cuts sheet metal: does not cut wood or acrylic
Software listed on the profile: test your workflow (LightBurn or maker app) on scrap first
Work area 3000 × 1500 mm (5 × 10 ft): confirm floor space, 3-phase power and loading before you order
cons: Does not cut wood, leather, or acrylic: sheet metal cutting only
Fume extraction still matters for coated metals and marking sprays
beginnerNotes: This profile covers OMTech FC-510 Intelli. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.

editorialDepth.advantages: OMTech FC-510 Intelli is an industrial fiber cutter (1.5–4 kW IPG source, 3000 × 1500 mm bed) for steel, stainless and aluminum parts. It suits fabrication shops that want to bring sheet cutting in-house instead of outsourcing.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip for engraving, wood, leather or acrylic, or without 3-phase 380 V power, assist gas and floor space for a multi-ton machine. Pricing is quote-based and installation is a project of its own.
